_comment: News beacon for the LinkedIn cycling series (#EsportesNoLinkedIn). Read by linkedin-beacon.mjs. Each lens is one angle the series covers; 'weight' steers selection toward the Black/Latin focus without excluding the rest of the sport. Edit freely: empty or failing feeds are skipped.
_verified: Feeds and queries tested 2026-11-13. In a 14-day window the narrow PT 'ciclista negro' and ES 'afrodescendiente' queries returned 0 items, so the beacon ALSO reads the big English cycling outlets and keeps only items that match a lens keyword. That is where the Black/African/Latin pro-peloton stories actually surface (Girmay, Team Amani, visas, Colombian riders). Rejected: pedal.com.br (403), cbc.esp.br (fetch failed), ciclismointernacional.com (404), bikemagazine.com.br (520).
